en:environmental-score-origins-of-ingred: Where the ingredients come from is not known at all, so that part of the environmental score cannot be worked out.
en:environmental-score-packaging-packagi: No packaging details were entered, so the environmental score leaves the packaging out.
en:environmental-score-packaging-unspeci: The shape of the packaging was not given, so it cannot be rated.
en:environmental-score-packaging-unscore: The packaging has a shape the environmental score has no rating for.
en:environmental-score-production-system: No farming label (such as organic) is listed, so the product gets no credit for how it was farmed.
en:food-groups-1-known: The broad food group is known (for example "cereals" or "milk").
en:food-groups-2-known: The more specific food group is known too.
en:food-groups-3-unknown: The most specific food group is not known.
en:packaging-data-incomplete: Some packaging details are there, but some are missing (for example the material).
en:no-packaging-data: No packaging details were entered at all.
en:nutrition-energy-value-in-kcal-does-n: The energy written in kcal and the energy written in kJ do not agree with each other.
en:nutrition-packaging-as-sold-100g-ener: Same problem, on the figures for the product as sold: the kcal and kJ energy do not agree.
en:nutrition-energy-value-in-kcal-does-n: The energy figure does not match what the fat, carbohydrates and protein add up to.
en:nutrition-energy-value-in-kcal-may-no: The energy figure may be off from what the fat, carbohydrates and protein add up to (a weaker warning).
en:nutrition-packaging-as-sold-100g-ener: Same as above, on the figures for the product as sold.
Same weaker warning, on the figures for the product as sold.
en:nutrition-sugars-plus-starch-plus-fib: Sugars, starch and fibre add up to more than the total carbohydrates, which cannot be right.
en:nutrition-value-very-high-for-categor: The energy is unusually high for this kind of food.
The salt is unusually high for this kind of food.
The protein is unusually high for this kind of food.
en:nutrition-value-under-0-001-g-salt: The salt is written as under 0.001 g, which is probably a typing slip.
en:nutri-score-grade-from-label-does-not: The Nutri-Score letter on the pack differs from the one worked out from the nutrition figures.
